Rw.bar_b_note: A clean, warmly lit elder villager in a Meadows green/brown palette with a readable face carries it, though the big-eyed animated-film face sits a little more cartoon than the key art's stylised realism.

Cd.bar_b_note: B's larger wrapped text and glyph prompts are readable, but the panel has no teal interaction accent, its tall rows show only three recipes, and it sits over a murky unlit world, so it reads as a functional prototype rather than a shipping UI.

Az.bar_b_note: B's site-specific aftermaths (opened cage with a freed villager, fallen banner, smoking dead campfire) tell the story, but blurry stretched ground textures, flat terrain, the tiled stone wall in row 1 and small sparse props sink the finish.

Jq.bar_b_note: The fight is hard to read: a dense HUD covers the bottom quarter of every frame, small trainers sit behind a large ally, and the hits are carried by pale flat floor outlines and a gold burst decal rather than real effects with impact.

Mx.bar_b_note: A's furred, spotted boar is close to the naturalistic owner bar but is only about the trainer's height and its hit react matches its standing pose; B's smooth clay body with moss decals reads as a toy and falls off-style.

Zz.bar_b_note: The timber-and-stone village with a chapel landmark and a readable golden-hour grade is close, but the place has no people or smoke, the rain frames wash out to a flat grey horizon, and there is no fog depth or light shafts, so it stops short of Valheim-class atmosphere.

top_changes.change: Replace the blurry stretched ground textures and flat even grass on Meadows terrain (Az, Jq) with clustered grass, flowers, dirt patches and terrain undulation, and add aerial-perspective fog and sun shafts so distance reads

Clear the combat read: shrink and collapse the bottom combat HUD, scale or offset the ally so both trainers stay visible, and swap the flat floor-outline telegraphs and gold burst decal for real-object effects (stone, dust, sparks) with hurt poses
Bring every creature to the naturalistic owner bar and above the 1.80 m ruler: Mx side B's clay-smooth boar needs a real fur/hide material and mesh, and both boars need more height
